title: No column supports the craft's 53-ft floor

tellings.quote: And there is nothing that was visually witnessed on the bottom level when he peeked that is a supporting column holding that 53-ft diameter floor.

plain: Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on alien craft at S-4, a secret site in Nevada, in 1988 and 1989, reports peeking into the bottom level of one craft and seeing no column holding up its 53-foot-wide floor. The researcher Luigi Vendittelli, who spent 48 hours with Lazar, draws this out on the show: "there is nothing that was visually witnessed on the bottom level... that is a supporting column holding that 53-ft diameter floor." The point is that a floor that size with no support would need building methods beyond ours.
